name: Dynamic Encounter Spawner
description: Pop-in with a level conscience. When a chunk activates, this rolls the encounter table for its biome and level band, asks combat.enemy_tier_scaling for the multiplier set, and places the group where the player is not currently looking — spawning in view reads as a bug even when it is a feature. It owns only the birth: the moment a mob exists it belongs to world.mob_patrol for behaviour and combat.damage_resolver for outcomes. Culling is symmetric — encounters that outlive their relevance leave through world.streaming_world_loader's lifecycle, never by vanishing, because a mob that blinks out mid-chase teaches the player the world is wallpaper.

inputs.name: encounterTables
inputs.description: Per-biome tables of group compositions and weights. The table is content; the spawner is the referee that keeps it fair.

inputs.name: minSpawnDistanceFromPlayer
inputs.description: No spawns inside this radius. Combined with the out-of-sight rule, this is the difference between 'the world is alive' and 'enemies teleport at you'.

inputs.name: spawnOutOfSight
inputs.description: Require spawn points to be outside the player's current view. Turning this off is valid for ambush-setpiece games and wrong for almost everyone else.

inputs.name: respawnCooldownSeconds
inputs.description: Minimum time before a cleared chunk may roll a new encounter. Five minutes keeps backtracking calm without making the world feel emptied.

outputs.name: activeEncounters
outputs.description: Live spawned groups, for density telemetry.
